about:
RFL Manufacturing operates from a facility at 1146 West Hilton Avenue in Phoenix, Arizona. The company describes itself as the Southwest's newest name in general roof flashing, though no founding year or founder names are disclosed. Ownership structure is not specified in available materials.

The company produces standard general roof flashings for tile and shingle roof markets across Arizona and the Southwest, along with its proprietary Coronado Vents™ tile roof vent system. The vent line includes a primary vent and streamlined secondary vents designed to simplify installation and reduce total installed cost. RFL also offers a panel roof system line. The operation appears small-scale; the website footer indicates a headcount of 1–5.

Products are sold exclusively through roofing distributors rather than direct to contractors or homeowners. The distributor network serves the Arizona and Southwest tile and shingle roofing sectors. Quick delivery within the Phoenix metropolitan area is emphasized as a service advantage.

RFL positions its Coronado Vents™ as a market-moving innovation rather than a me-too product, citing simplified installation, improved roof aesthetics, and lower overall cost as the design drivers. The company states it is "not just here to match the market" but to move it forward.
